title: anneal hooks metadata
description: Sidecar to hooks.json: one row per hook entry, so scaffolding can be re-tested and removed as models improve. Checked by crates/anneal-cli/tests/it/hooks_manifest.rs, which also keeps this schema and its serde DTO in agreement.

id.description: Stable id: the hooks.json entry runs `anneal hook <id>`. Skills may name it as a MUST's enforcer.

event.description: The Claude Code event the entry is declared under.

matcher.description: The entry's matcher, exactly; empty when it has none.

fingerprint.description: sha256: and the first 16 hex digits of SHA-256 over `<event>\n<matcher>\n<the hook object as compact JSON, keys sorted>`. Changes whenever the entry does, so the row is re-read.

on_failure.description: The entry's onFailure: continue (fail open) or block (a guard fails closed).

role.description: scaffolding helps a model generation and is re-tested, then removed, as models improve; guard enforces a gate.

model_generation.description: The Claude model generation the hook was added for.

source.description: Where the hook is specified: blueprint section and story.
